errors.text_span: There are four groups of bars,
errors.evidence: The chart shows three groups of bars, one for each Stage on the x-axis. Each group contains four bars representing the different mechanisms.

errors.text_span: with values around 0.15 for all stages
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for the grouped attention (red) bars. While the value for Stage 1 is close to 0.15 (approx. 0.16), the values for Stage 2 (approx. 0.11) and Stage 3 (approx. 0.10) are significantly lower.

errors.text_span: with values around 0.12 for all stages
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for the patch attention (yellow) bars. The values for all three stages are below 0.12 (approx. 0.11, 0.10, and 0.09 respectively).

The values for the feed-forward (green) bars in Stage 2 and Stage 3 are both approximately 0.12, not 0.13 and 0.14. The description incorrectly reports these values and suggests a rising trend that does not exist.
The description fails to mention the legend at the top of the chart, which is essential for identifying which color corresponds to which attention mechanism or feed-forward module.
The description groups all four modules as 'attention mechanisms', but one of them, 'feed-forward', is a distinct type of module, as indicated by its name and separation in the legend.
